2608.25934.title: How Robust Are Automated Fact-Checking Systems? A Cross-Benchmark Evaluation
2608.25934.paper_summary: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems retrieve evidence and predict claim veracity, yet evaluations omit simple baselines, systems are developed for a single benchmark and cannot be trusted to generalise across domains. No prior work cross-evaluates the full two-stage retrieve-then-verify pipeline across diverse datasets, complementing retrieval-only studies (Thakur et al., 2021) and single-stage benchmarking studies (Calamai et al., 2025). We benchmark nine models, ranging from random and sparse baselines to fine-tuned transformers, zero-shot LLMs, and the two highest-ranked systems from the AVeriTeC 2025 shared task, across four datasets spanning scientific, open-web, and climate domains. Three findings stand out: (1) on ClimateCheck claim-only and fine-tuned models outperform zero-shot LLM and top-performing AVeriTeC 2025 systems, highlighting that noisy evidence can degrade veracity prediction; (2) system rankings are strongly domain- and metric-dependent: the best model on SciFact (macro-F1 0.70) drops to 0.31 on ClimateCheck, while the AVeriTeC 2025 winner and runner-up swap rankings based on evaluation metrics and datasets; (3) replacing retrieved evidence with gold annotations improves veracity accuracy by 14-22 points across models, confirming retrieval remains primary bottleneck. We release code, pre-processed datasets, and all results to support reproducible AFC research.
2608.25934.paper_summary_zh: 自動化事實查核（AFC）系統檢索證據並預測聲明的真實性，但評估中省略了簡單的基準，系統是為單一基準開發的，無法信任其能夠跨領域泛化。之前的工作沒有跨評估完整的兩階段檢索-然後-驗證流程，這補充了僅檢索的研究（Thakur et al., 2021）和單階段基準研究（Calamai et al., 2025）。我們對九個模型進行基準測試，範圍從隨機和稀疏基準到微調的Transformer、零樣本LLM，以及來自AVeriTeC 2025共享任務的兩個最高排名系統，涵蓋四個數據集，這些數據集跨越科學、開放網絡和氣候領域。有三個發現突出： (1) 在ClimateCheck中，僅聲明和微調模型的表現優於零樣本LLM和表現最佳的AVeriTeC 2025系統，突顯出噪聲證據會降低真實性預測； (2) 系統排名強烈依賴於領域和指標：在SciFact上的最佳模型（宏F1 0.70）在ClimateCheck上降至0.31，而AVeriTeC 2025的獲勝者和亞軍根據評估指標和數據集互換排名； (3) 用金標註替換檢索的證據可使模型的真實性準確度提高14-22個點，確認檢索仍然是主要瓶頸。我們發布代碼、預處理數據集和所有結果，以支持可重複的AFC研究。
